description: This PHP class 'StrLength' defines a rule for validating the length of a string, with configurable minimum and maximum bounds, encoding, and inclusivity options. It is used within a validation framework in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: StrLength
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a string's length falls within specified bounds, considering encoding and inclusivity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with optional min, max, encoding, and inclusivity settings. Throws exception if max is less than min.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the length of the input string (considering encoding) satisfies the set min and max constraints.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Private helper method that validates whether the string length meets the minimum requirement, considering inclusivity.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Private helper method that validates whether the string length does not exceed the maximum limit, considering inclusivity.
